title: Bonds, Stocks Fall as US and Iran Step Up Rhetoric: Markets Wrap
title_zh: 随着美国和伊朗的言辞升级，债券和股票下跌：市场结束
summary: S&P 500 futures dropped 0.6% hours ahead of US President Donald Trump’s deadline for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Iran carried out fresh strikes across the Persian Gulf and kept the waterway effectively shut, with Brent crude up 0.6% around $113.
summary_zh: 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普为伊朗重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的最后期限前几个小时，标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 0.6%。伊朗在波斯湾发动了新的袭击，并有效关闭了水道，布伦特原油上涨0.6%，约为113美元。

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: London plunges into correction territory as Trump gives Iran ultimatum
title_zh: 富时 100 实时：特朗普向伊朗发出最后通牒，伦敦陷入调整区间

title: Exclusive-EU digital rules should apply to Big Tech's smart TVs, broadcasters tell antitrust chief
title_zh: 广播公司告诉反垄断主管，欧盟专有数字规则应适用于大型科技公司的智能电视
summary: Google, Amazon, Apple and Samsung's smart TVs and virtual assistants should fall under the EU's toughest tech rules because of their growing market power, the world's largest ‌broadcasters told EU antitrust chief Teresa Ribera on Monday.
summary_zh: 全球最大的广播公司周一告诉欧盟反垄断主管特蕾莎·里贝拉，谷歌、亚马逊、苹果和三星的智能电视和虚拟助手由于市场力量不断增强，应受到欧盟最严格的科技规则的约束。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures sink as Iran launches strikes in face of Trump warning
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货下跌，因伊朗面对特朗普警告发动袭击
summary: Markets are on edge for an escalation in the Mideast war after Trump gave Iran a 2-day deadline to reopen Hormuz or face heavy bombing.

title: Musk says SpaceX and Tesla to build advanced chip factories in Austin
title_zh: 马斯克表示 SpaceX 和特斯拉将在奥斯汀建造先进芯片工厂
summary: LOS ANGELES, March 22 (Reuters) - SpaceX and Tesla will build two advanced chip factories at a sprawling facility in Austin, ‌Texas, one to power cars and humanoid robots, and another designed ‌for artificial intelligence data centers in space, CEO Elon Musk said on Sunday.
summary_zh: 路透洛杉矶 3 月 22 日 - 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 周日表示，SpaceX 和特斯拉将在德克萨斯州奥斯汀的一座庞大工厂建造两座先进芯片工厂，一座为汽车和人形机器人提供动力，另一座为太空人工智能数据中心设计。

title: 3 weeks of war, possible rate hikes, and AI's 'show me' phase: What to watch this week
title_zh: 持续三周的战争、可能的加息以及人工智能的“展示”阶段：本周值得关注的内容
summary: As the war in Iran rolls into its fourth week, continued energy market disruption and renewed bets on rate hikes by the Fed should capture investor attention in the week ahead.
summary_zh: 随着伊朗战争进入第四周，能源市场的持续混乱和美联储加息的新赌注应该会在未来一周引起投资者的关注。
